# RelayHub Docs

> Application relay for signed HTTP, durable events, routing rules, realtime channels, callbacks, standard WebSocket and remote functions. Markdown is canonical; v1 is still under development.

## Start
- [User guide](https://relayhub.dungxbuif.com/docs/user.md)
- [Developer guide](https://relayhub.dungxbuif.com/docs/developer.md)
- [Registration](https://relayhub.dungxbuif.com/docs/developer/registration-flow.md)
- [Exact HMAC signing](https://relayhub.dungxbuif.com/docs/developer/auth.md)
- [Events and delivery API](https://relayhub.dungxbuif.com/docs/developer/api-overview.md)
- [Routing relay and realtime channels](https://relayhub.dungxbuif.com/docs/developer/routing-realtime.md)
- [Callbacks, retries and dead letter](https://relayhub.dungxbuif.com/docs/developer/reliability.md)
- [WebSocket and reconnect](https://relayhub.dungxbuif.com/docs/developer/websocket.md)
- [Durable streaming protocol](https://relayhub.dungxbuif.com/docs/developer/streaming-protocol.md)
- [Remote functions](https://relayhub.dungxbuif.com/docs/developer/functions.md)
